component: IMAP non-inbox status and header-fetch boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch queues eligible non-inbox folders for STATUS even when their database association is open. If a changed summary comes from a non-selected target, it schedules UpdateFolder(nullptr) so status counts can lead to a full folder update. The same connection-selected mailbox uses NOOP and its idle-style path. The spec flag comes from whether the parser receives a named STATUS mailbox, not global tab state or every connection. The serial queue and DB association release are separate boundaries. Later unread-notification/pref changes are not part of this landing. No header download, timeout recovery or test was executed.
title: Changed IMAP STATUS results schedule a folder update when the target is not selected on that connection
